name: Yamnaya
description: Pastoral nomadic culture of the Pontic-Caspian steppe, widely associated with the spread of Proto-Indo-European languages into Europe

name: Sredny Stog
description: Eneolithic culture in the Pontic steppe region, possible precursor to Yamnaya

name: Corded Ware
description: Major archaeological horizon across Northern and Central Europe, linked to Indo-European expansion

name: Bell Beaker
description: Widespread European cultural phenomenon characterized by distinctive bell-shaped pottery

name: Afanasievo
description: Easternmost extension of Yamnaya-related populations into the Altai-Sayan region

name: Andronovo
description: Bronze Age culture across the Central Asian steppe, associated with Indo-Iranian expansion

name: Sintashta
description: Fortified settlements with earliest known chariots, linked to Proto-Indo-Iranian

name: Catacomb

name: Srubnaya (Timber Grave)

description: Long-lived pre-agricultural culture of Japan, known for the world's oldest pottery
